candidates.title: Interstellar
candidates.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage. Driven by love and survival, they race against time as Earth faces extinction.

candidates.title: Dune
candidates.overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence, only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

candidates.title: Inception
candidates.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

candidates.title: The Matrix
candidates.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth. He discovers that perceived reality is actually a simulated reality created by sentient machines.

candidates.title: The Martian
candidates.overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

candidates.title: Blade Runner 2049
candidates.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.

candidates.title: The Shape of Water
candidates.overview: An other-worldly story, set against the backdrop of Cold War era America circa 1962. In the hidden high-security government laboratory where she works, lonely Elisa is trapped in a life of isolation. Elisa's life is changed forever when she and co-worker Zelda discover a secret classified experiment.

candidates.title: Arrival
candidates.overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat. As she learns their cyclical non-linear language, she experiences flashes of her own future.

candidates.title: Oppenheimer
candidates.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II. A gripping psychological examination of brilliant theoretical physics, bureaucratic paranoia, and catastrophic historical guilt.

candidates.title: Dune: Part Two
candidates.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

candidates.title: Poor Things
candidates.overview: The incredible tale about the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter. Hungry for the worldliness she is lacking, Bella runs off on a whirlwind adventure across the continents.

candidates.title: Avengers: Infinity War
candidates.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones.

candidates.title: Parasite
candidates.overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident. A dark, razor-sharp social satire dissecting modern class divisions and greed.

candidates.title: Gone Girl
candidates.overview: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent. A chilling examination of media sensationalism and marital toxicity.

candidates.title: Civil War
candidates.overview: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House. A harrowing, visceral look at modern civil conflict through a photojournalist's lens.

candidates.title: The Dark Knight
candidates.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

candidates.title: Challengers
candidates.overview: Tennis player-turned-coach Tashi has taken her husband, Art, and transformed him into a world-famous grand slam champion. To jolt him out of his recent losing streak, she enters him into a challenger event where he finds himself facing off against Patrick, his former best friend and Tashi's ex-boyfriend.

candidates.title: Jumanji
candidates.overview: When siblings Judy and Peter discover an enchanted board game that opens the door to a magical world, they unwittingly invite Alan Parrish, a man trapped in the game for 26 years, into their living room.

candidates.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
candidates.overview: Singer Freddie Mercury, guitarist Brian May, drummer Roger Taylor and bass guitarist John Deacon take the music world by storm when they form the rock 'n' roll band Queen in 1970. Hitting the heights of fame, Mercury faces internal turbulence and AIDS diagnosis leading up to Live Aid.

candidates.title: Past Lives
candidates.overview: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Two decades later, they are reunited in New York for one fateful week as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

candidates.title: Toy Story
candidates.overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo reluctantly learn to work together.
